core.title: Exactly one documentation-graph resolver
core.given: The documentation-graph resolver: the one component that resolves the relationship attributes of authored documents.
core.when: You plan code that resolves document relationship attributes.
core.then: There MUST be exactly ONE documentation-graph resolver: every consumer resolves document relationships through it, and no second implementation may be added.
prefer: Call the existing resolver instead of re-resolving document relationship targets locally in the consumer.
avoid: A second resolver implementation — an independent lookup of document relationships, for example inside another registry or inside a check.
evidence: There is exactly one resolver implementation. It may span several modules, and no other code path resolves document relationship attributes.
verification: A repository-wide check confirms there is exactly ONE implementation that resolves document relationship attributes; the one resolver may span several modules, and no other code path may resolve them.
Severity 1, disposition strict: the check fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

fires: A plan adds a second place that resolves document relationships, for example a separate lookup inside another registry or inside a check.
doesNotFire: Pure document authoring with no resolver work.

profileRequirements.meaning: The file kind of the authored documents whose relationship attributes the resolver resolves; it scopes the corpus the rule and its check reason about.
The markup constructs by which an authored document declares its document identifier and references another document's identifier — the attributes whose resolution belongs to the one resolver.

neutralityNotes: The obligation itself is stack-neutral (exactly one resolver for document cross-reference resolution); only surface syntax was realization-bound. Neutralized: the `.adoc` markup suffix (activation.facts[1] note, and the non-item doesNotFire wording 'Pure .adoc authoring' → 'Pure document authoring') is supplied by the profile as suffix.markup ('.adoc' in Bun); the `:doc-id:` attribute syntax in prefer[0] is supplied by the proposed key idiom.docs_syntax#doc_relationship; and the 'spec 2 §5.4 / #1755' provenance in why, avoid[0] and verifier_detail[0] is repository history kept in bunOnly. The activation fact notes and the fires/doesNotFire wording are not enumerated items, so their stack-specific residue is recorded here rather than in bunOnly. audit[0]'s severity and disposition went to core:verification per the notProfileKeys rule; the validator id went to bunOnly.
